resources.string: NetShare-style modes create the customer network while the phone stays connected to its own WiFi, so no hotspot toggle is needed - the phone receives internet on one interface and serves customers on another. They need Location permission and Location switched ON (Android refuses to create any WiFi network otherwise). \"Automatic\" tries: existing hotspot, system hotspot command (Android 12+), local-only hotspot, WiFi Direct, root hostapd - and logs every attempt with the reason it failed.

Android only lets an app create a WiFi network (hotspot, local-only hotspot or WiFi Direct group) when it has location permission - and Location must also be switched on in the system settings. Without them every NetShare-style mode fails, and the debugger will report the reason.
